paper_details.subjectName: Pair of Linear Equations – Pair of Linear Equations

definitionBean.title: Graphical Method (Graphical Method)
definitionBean.definition: Pair of Linear Equationsों को आलेख (ग्राफ) at रेखाओं of रूप in खींचकर उनof Point of Intersection from solution ज्ञात करने of विधि।
definitionBean.explanation: प्रत्येक रैखिक equation एक सरल रेखा को निरूपित करता है। both रेखाएँ if एक point at ofटें then वह point ही equation युग्म of अद्वितीय solution है। if रेखाएँ समांतर हों then कोई solution नहीं होता, and if both रेखाएँ संपाती (same रेखा) हों then अनंत solution होते हैं।
importantPoints: At least two points must be found for each equation

definitionBean.title: Substitution Method (Substitution Method)
definitionBean.definition: this विधि in एक equation from किसी एक variable of मान दूसरे variable of रूप in ज्ञात कर, उfrom दूसरे equation in रखकर solution ज्ञात किया जाता है।
definitionBean.explanation: पsolutionे किसी एक equation from x या y in from एक variable को दूसरे of पदों in व्यक्त करते हैं, फिर उfrom दूसरे equation in प्रतिस्थापित (substitute) करof एक variable of equation बनाते हैं and उfrom solution करते हैं।
importantPoints: Express one variable in terms of the other from one equation
Substitute it into the other equation
Substitute the value back into the original equation to find the other variable

definitionBean.title: Elimination Method (Elimination Method)
definitionBean.definition: this विधि in both equationों को this प्रofर multiply किया जाता है कि किसी एक variable of coefficients बराबर हो जाएँ, फिर add/subtractकर उस variable को समाप्त (विलोपित) कर दिया जाता है।
definitionBean.explanation: both equationों in from किसी एक variable of coefficientsों को बराबर करने for equationों को उपयुक्त numberओं from multiply किया जाता है। फिर both equationों को addने या subtractने from एक variable समाप्त हो जाता है and दूसरे variable of मान सीधे obtained is।
importantPoints: Multiply the equations to make the coefficients equal
Add or subtract to eliminate one variable
Find the value of the remaining variable
Substitute the value back to find the other variable

definitionBean.title: Cross Multiplication Method (Cross Multiplication Method)
definitionBean.definition: a1x + b1y + c1 = 0 and a2x + b2y + c2 = 0 of रूप of equationों को एक निश्चित formula द्वारा सीधे solution करने of विधि।
definitionBean.explanation: क्रॉस मल्टिप्लिofशन विधि in x/(b1c2-b2c1) = y/(c1a2-c2a1) = 1/(a1b2-a2b1) formula of प्रsum कर सीधे x and y of मान ज्ञात किए जाते हैं। यह विधि विशेष रूप from तब उपsumी है जब coefficients जटिल हों।
importantPoints: यह विधि substitution and elimination from तेज़ हो सकती है
coefficientsों को सही क्रम in रखना आवश्यक है

parts.statement:
निम्न रैखिक equation युग्म को Substitution Method from solution ofजिए:
7x - 15y = 2
x + 2y = 3
parts.explanation:
equation (1): 7x - 15y = 2
equation (2): x + 2y = 3

equation (2) from x of मान निofलने at:
x = 3 - 2y  --(equation 3)

x of यह मान equation (1) in रखने at:
7(3 - 2y) - 15y = 2
21 - 14y - 15y = 2
21 - 29y = 2
-29y = 2 - 21
-29y = -19
y = 19/29

y of मान equation (3) in रखने at:
x = 3 - 2(19/29)
x = 3 - 38/29
x = (87 - 38) / 29
x = 49/29

Therefore solution x = 49/29 and y = 19/29 है।

parts.statement:
Substitution Method द्वारा solution ofजिए:
s - t = 3
s/3 + t/2 = 6
parts.explanation:
equation (1): s - t = 3 => s = t + 3
equation (2): s/3 + t/2 = 6

s of मान equation (2) in रखने at:
(t + 3)/3 + t/2 = 6
लघुत्तम (LCM) लेकर On solving:
[2(t + 3) + 3t] / 6 = 6
2t + 6 + 3t = 36
5t + 6 = 36
5t = 30 => t = 6

t of मान s = t + 3 in रखने at:
s = 6 + 3 = 9

Therefore s = 9 and t = 6 है।

parts.statement:
Elimination Method of प्रsum하여 निम्न equation युग्म of all possible solution find:
3x + 4y = 10
2x - 2y = 2
parts.explanation:
equation (1): 3x + 4y = 10
equation (2): 2x - 2y = 2

y of coefficients बराबर करने for equation (2) in 2 from multiply करने at:
4x - 4y = 4  --(equation 3)

अब equation (1) and (3) को addने at:
(3x + 4y) + (4x - 4y) = 10 + 4
7x = 14 => x = 2

x of मान equation (2) in रखने at:
2(2) - 2y = 2
4 - 2y = 2
-2y = 2 - 4
-2y = -2 => y = 1

Therefore x = 2 and y = 1 है।

parts.statement:
Elimination Method from solution ofजिए:
x + y = 5
2x - 3y = 4
parts.explanation:
equation (1): x + y = 5
equation (2): 2x - 3y = 4

x of coefficients बराबर करने for equation (1) in 2 from multiply करने at:
2x + 2y = 10  --(equation 3)

equation (3) in from equation (2) subtractने at:
(2x + 2y) - (2x - 3y) = 10 - 4
2y + 3y = 6
5y = 6 => y = 6/5

y of मान equation (1) in रखने at:
x + 6/5 = 5
x = 5 - 6/5
x = (25 - 6) / 5 = 19/5

Therefore x = 19/5 and y = 6/5 है।

parts.statement: दो numberओं of अंतर 26 है and एक number दूसरी number of तीन गुनी है। उन्हें find।
parts.explanation:
Let larger number x and smaller number y है।
प्रश्नुसार:
1) x - y = 26  --(equation 1)
2) x = 3y    --(equation 2)

x of यह मान equation (1) in रखने at (Substitution Method):
3y - y = 26
2y = 26 => y = 13

y of मान equation (2) in रखने at:
x = 3(13) = 39

Therefore numberएँ 39 and 13 हैं।

parts.statement: एक fraction of numerator and denominator both in 2 add दिया जाए, then वह 9/11 हो जाती है। if numerator and denominator both in 3 add दिया जाए, then वह 5/6 हो जाती है। वह fraction find।
parts.explanation:
Let fraction x/y है।
According to the first condition:
(x + 2) / (y + 2) = 9/11
11(x + 2) = 9(y + 2)
11x + 22 = 9y + 18
11x - 9y = -4  --(equation 1)

According to the second condition:
(x + 3) / (y + 3) = 5/6
6(x + 3) = 5(y + 3)
6x + 18 = 5y + 15
6x - 5y = -3  --(equation 2)

equation (1) को 5 from and (2) को 9 from multiply करof subtractने at:
55x - 45y = -20
54x - 45y = -27
-----------------
x = 7

x of मान equation (1) in रखने at:
11(7) - 9y = -4
77 - 9y = -4
-9y = -81 => y = 9

Therefore required fraction 7/9 है।
